_doc.purpose: Concrete shape for the per-asset-group range-index files proposed in manifest_scaling_range_index_2026_05.plan.md
_doc.principle: One bucket per asset_group, one _index/range_index.parquet per (bucket, layer). Each bucket's index has its own schema — sports does not pretend to share columns with cefi.

layers.1_instruments: Layer 1 — what can be tradeable. Owned by instruments-service. Path: gs://instruments-store-{asset_group}-{project}/_index/range_index.parquet
layers.2_raw: Layer 2 — what was ingested per (instrument, data_type). Owned by MTDS. Path: gs://market-data-tick-{asset_group}-{project}/_index/raw_range_index.parquet
layers.3_processed: Layer 3 — what was aggregated per (instrument, data_type, timeframe). Owned by MDPS. Path: gs://market-data-tick-{asset_group}-{project}/_index/processed_range_index.parquet

common_columns_all_layers.covered_from: ISO date — first day with confirmed coverage
common_columns_all_layers.covered_to: ISO date — last day with confirmed coverage
common_columns_all_layers.gap_dates: list[ISO date] — pipeline failures (NOT weekends/holidays). Holidays come from instrument's calendar, not this list.
common_columns_all_layers.shard_count: int — number of underlying GCS shards this row summarises
common_columns_all_layers.bytes_total: int — sum of bytes across all underlying shards
common_columns_all_layers.last_compacted_at: ISO timestamp UTC — when the nightly compactor wrote this row
common_columns_all_layers.instrument_id: canonical UAC instrument key — the FK to Layer 1

fk_invariants: every Layer 3 (processed) row has its (asset_group, instrument_id, data_type) covered by a Layer 2 row
every Layer 2 (raw) row has its instrument_id covered by a Layer 1 row in the matching asset_group bucket
violations raise alerts in the compactor; do not silently break reads

cefi._schema_notes: Single shape across spot, perpetual, future, option. Empty string for columns that don't apply (e.g. strike on a spot row).

layer_2_raw._note: Options data is bundled per (venue, underlying, quote, margin) — one row in this index represents the chain bundle, not per-strike. Per-strike rows live in Layer 1 only.

tradfi._schema_notes: TradFi gets per-venue trading_hours / timezone / holiday_calendar — these come from instrument_schema_cohesion plan's Phase 2C. Used by the compactor to distinguish 'real gap' from 'market closed'.

layer_2_raw._note: Futures chain bundled by underlying — one row covers all front+back months
Options chain bundled — one row covers all strikes/expiries for SPX

defi._schema_notes: DEFI carries chain + protocol_version + pool_address. No timezone/holiday — DEFI is 24/7 by definition. Pools, lending markets, LSTs share the schema; columns that don't apply (fee_tier_bps for lending) stay empty.

sports._schema_notes: Sports has its own world. Identity = (league, fixture). Time semantics = kickoff_ts (a moment, not a session). Raw data is per-bookmaker odds over horizons (T-24h, T-12h, ... T-0). Processed = horizon-bucketed odds aggregations. Layer 1 'instrument' is a fixture; Layer 2/3 reference the fixture but key on (fixture, bookmaker, market).

layer_2_raw._note: Sports raw is per-fixture-per-bookmaker over time horizons before kickoff. covered_from/to bound the captured odds-stream window.

layer_3_processed._note: Sports processing buckets odds per horizon (T-24h, T-12h, T-6h, T-4h, T-2h, T-1h, T-10m, T-0). One row per (fixture, horizon).

prediction._schema_notes: Prediction markets are smart-contract-event-keyed. Identity = (venue, event_id, outcome). Like sports, has a defined close_ts (when the market resolves). Unlike sports there's no horizon-bucketing in processed today; processed is per-timeframe price aggregation similar to crypto.
